ValidationRule.description: Require Account Industry, using validation rule instead of field requirement so it can be bypassed by Flow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name = 'B2B', RecordType.Name = 'Travel', RecordType.Name = 'Education', RecordType.Name = 'Healthcare', Acc_Val_Bypass__c = false, ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Industry__c)) )
